questions.title: Which club will win Manchester United's opening match of the 2026–27 Premier League season?
questions.resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: The official Premier League match result, corroborated by contemporaneous reporting from established sports news outlets.
  • Resolution: Resolve according to the full-time result of Manchester United's opening Premier League fixture, scheduled for August 22, 2026.
  • Accepted Answer Format: Return the winning club's name. If the match finishes level, return “Draw”.
questions.accepted_format: Return the winning club's name. If the match finishes level, return “Draw”.

questions.title: Which UEFA competition's league phase will Celtic enter in the 2026–27 season?
questions.background: Celtic are seeking a place in the 2026–27 UEFA Champions League through the qualifying playoffs.
questions.resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: UEFA's official qualification results, corroborated by contemporaneous match reporting.
  • Resolution Rule: Resolve to the European competition whose league phase Celtic qualify for following the completion of their August 2026 Champions League qualifying-playoff tie.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The competition's standard name.

questions.title: Who will win the PFA Men's Players' Player of the Year award for the 2025–26 season?
questions.background: The Professional Footballers’ Association (PFA) presents annual awards recognizing outstanding players in English professional football, with winners selected by fellow players.
questions.resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: The PFA’s official announcement of its Men's Players' Player of the Year award for the 2025–26 season, or reliable news reporting of that announcement.
  • Resolution: Resolve when the winner is publicly announced.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The winning player's full name.

questions.title: Which club will win the Aston Villa–Arsenal Premier League match scheduled for August 31, 2026?
questions.resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: The Premier League’s official full-time result, corroborated by contemporaneous reporting from established sports news outlets.
  • Resolution: Resolve after the conclusion of Aston Villa’s home Premier League fixture against Arsenal scheduled for August 31, 2026, using the final score.
  • Accepted Answer Format: Return the winning club’s commonly used name. If the match finishes level, return “Draw”.
questions.accepted_format: Return the winning club’s commonly used name. If the match finishes level, return “Draw”.

questions.title: Who will Ghana appoint to lead the Black Stars for the September–October 2026 international window?
questions.background: The Black Stars are Ghana's senior men's national football team.
questions.resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: The Ghana Football Association's official announcement appointing a head coach for the international window running from September 21 to October 6, 2026, corroborated by reliable news reporting.
  • Resolution Condition: Resolve to the first person appointed after August 1, 2026, and before the international window begins, to lead the team during that window. Both interim and permanent appointments qualify.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The appointed coach's full name.

questions.title: Who will score the opening goal when Real Betis host Real Madrid in La Liga in September 2026?
questions.background: The opening goalscorer is the player officially credited with the first goal of the match.
questions.resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: La Liga's official match record, corroborated by reliable match reporting.
  • Resolution Conditions: Resolve to the player credited with the earliest goal in the September 2026 La Liga fixture hosted by Real Betis against Real Madrid. Disallowed goals do not count. If the match finishes goalless, resolve as “No goalscorer.”
  • Accepted Answer Format: The player's full name.

questions.title: Which club will lead the La Liga table immediately after the Valencia–Barcelona match scheduled for September 20, 2026?
questions.resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: Official La Liga standings or reputable contemporaneous match reports.
  • Resolution: Resolve to the club occupying first place in the La Liga table immediately after the completion of Valencia's home match against Barcelona scheduled for September 20, 2026. Use the league's official ranking rules if clubs are level on points.
  • Accepted Answer Format: Return the name of the first-placed club.
questions.accepted_format: Return the name of the first-placed club.

questions.title: Which company will Liverpool announce as its main shirt sponsor for the 2027–28 season?
questions.background: Standard Chartered has been Liverpool's main shirt sponsor since 2010. This sponsorship gives the company prominent branding on the front of the club's playing shirts.
questions.resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: Liverpool FC's official announcement identifying the company with an agreed main front-of-shirt sponsorship deal covering the 2027–28 season.
  • Resolution Timing: Resolve when the club announces the agreement, provided the announcement occurs between June 1 and December 31, 2026. The agreement's announcement, rather than the sponsorship's commencement, determines resolution.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The name of the sponsoring company. Sleeve sponsors, kit manufacturers, and other commercial partners do not qualify.
questions.accepted_format: The name of the sponsoring company. Sleeve sponsors, kit manufacturers, and other commercial partners do not qualify.

questions.title: Which club will win the Premier League match between Aston Villa and Nottingham Forest on September 12, 2026?
questions.resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: The official Premier League result or reliable contemporaneous match reports for Aston Villa versus Nottingham Forest on September 12, 2026.
  • Resolution: Resolve according to the full-time result, including stoppage time.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The winning club's name. If the match finishes level, indicate a draw.
questions.accepted_format: The winning club's name. If the match finishes level, indicate a draw.

questions.title: Which club will win the Manchester derby hosted by Manchester United in September 2026?
questions.resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: Official match records, corroborated by contemporaneous match reports, for the September 2026 Manchester derby hosted by Manchester United.
  • Resolution: Resolve to the club with more goals in the official final score after the match, including stoppage time. If the scores are level, resolve to “Draw”.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The winning club's name, or “Draw” if neither club wins.
questions.accepted_format: The winning club's name, or “Draw” if neither club wins.
